scope: User-reported subscription usage measurements forwarded by @drewbitt (X posts / community reposts / a personal log study). Evidence-only round: raw observations, derivations, and cross-checks against adopted rows are recorded; NO adopted values are changed in this PR. Per project convention, conflicting sources are all recorded and the maintainer adjudicates.
method: Each source's raw panel/tracker/log figures are kept as reported; implied pools are computed as reported_tokens / reported_quota_fraction; monthly = weekly × 4 (project standard). Dollar figures reported by trackers are list-price equivalents (worth口径) and are recorded as corroboration only, never converted to tokens. Screenshots are NOT committed (data/research is JSON-only); they are embedded in the PR body for review and the X permalinks are the provenance.
